about: Real cases for the scanner. Run with `npm run eval:scan` (uses Gemini and the Open Facts APIs). Expected values: vegan | vegetarian | non_vegetarian (food) | not_vegan (any animal use, non-food) | doubtful (anything but a definitive or probable vegan). Brand cases: cruelty_free | not_cruelty_free. `review: true` marks expectations still to be confirmed by Nils.
coverage_about: Products chosen FIRST (what people actually scan: products at home, a shopping list by category), then looked up. Measures whether each database knows the barcode, whether it has ingredients, and whether the final answer (including the web search) is right. Add products you own: gtin, what it is, category, expected verdict and `picked` (how it was chosen).
